endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: ny_nysdec_afton_route_41_unimproved_launch_anchor_20260918 nysdec-chenango-county-susquehanna-afton-launch-coordinate: NYSDEC's current Chenango County Boat Launch Sites directory lists the Susquehanna River at Afton at the exact shared route coordinate 42.228255,-75.523860, classifies it as an unimproved trailer launch, and lists parking for 12 cars and trailers. NYSDEC's Susquehanna River access page places the Afton gravel ramp at the Route 41 bridge. The published coordinate establishes the public launch site, but neither page identifies it as a surveyed wet-toe point. Retain the exact state coordinate as an authoritative access anchor and leave the mapped-water offset open for review.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (ny_nysdec_afton_route_41_unimproved_launch_anchor_20260918 nysdec-chenango-county-susquehanna-afton-launch-coordinate) on Susquehanna River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.
